title: Self-synchronization of Huffman codes
venue: IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory
relevance: Theoretical analysis of Huffman self-synchronization including expected sync distance for different code structures.

title: On Codeword Lengths Guaranteeing Synchronization
relevance: Characterizes which codeword length distributions guarantee synchronization and derives bounds on sync distance.
